name: claude
title: Anthropic review interface
summary: Adds Opus 5.5 cross-family review of GPT-authored campaigns, an optional Anthropic planning counterpart, and a user-routable Opus visual-development executor.

bin: claude (Claude CLI) - for cross-family review, planner-claude, and modeler-claude
env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an authenticated Claude CLI login

notes: GPT-authored campaigns route through one blocking project-scoped Opus 5.5 MCP transport call when this pack is installed.
Visual-development orders can explicitly route through modeler-claude to Opus 5.5/high or xhigh.
The Director transports the order; a fresh Claude CLI process performs the independent review.
A failed Claude lane is REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE, never approval; route to the fresh-context native OpenAI reviewer and report the cross-family fallback.
